title: 6 Essential Activities GTA6 Needs to Let Players Experience in Vice City
description: Polygon explores the expansive side activities in GTA6 and expresses hope that Rockstar leaves room for classic Vice City experiences.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Looking Ahead at GTA6 and Vice City

As anticipation continues to build for Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster, media outlets and fans alike are dissecting every piece of available information about the game. Recently, gaming publication Polygon shared a thoughtful perspective on the side activities and world design expected in GTA6, specifically focusing on how the game handles the iconic setting of Vice City.

## Expansive Side Activities and World Design

Based on current industry insights and promotional materials, the scope of GTA6's open world is set to be massive. A larger world naturally brings expectations for more diverse side content, emergent gameplay, and interactive opportunities. According to Polygon, while the side activities in GTA6 already appear expansive and deeply integrated into the world, there is a strong hope that Rockstar leaves enough room for specific, localized experiences that define the character of Vice City.

## Balancing Scale with Atmosphere

For longtime fans of the franchise, Vice City represents a distinct mood, aesthetic, and cultural vibe. As Rockstar pushes technical boundaries for modern hardware, balancing the sheer scale of the map with the intimate, atmospheric details of street-level life remains a key challenge. Analysis suggests that while high-tech features and sprawling landscapes are exciting, it is often these quieter, specialized activities that give a setting its true heartbeat.

## Editor's Take
Polygon's perspective highlights a crucial aspect of open-world game design: scale matters, but atmosphere is everything. We hope Rockstar successfully blends its ambitious new features with the beloved, neon-soaked soul of Vice City when GTA6 launches.
